variant.title: Jigsaw Sudoku
variant.description: Each puzzle-owned irregular region must contain no repeated digit.
rule.jigsaw_region_repeat: An irregular region cannot repeat a digit.
rule_guide.title: Jigsaw Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row and column must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Each marked irregular region must contain no repeated digit.
